metaDescription: Kevin and a guest discuss conspiracy theories, TikTok bans, AI company economics, and TESCREAL ideologies behind Sam Altman and AI doomers.
summary: Kevin and a guest discuss conspiracy theories and AI, arguing that AI as a technology is not evil but the people and centralized companies controlling it are. Kevin says he was banned from TikTok after Larry Ellison's takeover, and argues AI labs are economically shaky and may need a taxpayer bailout. He says Sam Altman and others are openly transhumanist, and claims AI doomers fall into TESCREAL's effective altruist or rationalist camps, wanting humans preserved so they can become posthuman. The conversation also covers honeypot-style stories Kevin has reported on and the data-ownership concerns raised by the guest.
